available.quote: The board has the power to grant a reciprocal license without further examination to an applicant who is licensed or certified as a massage therapist or similar practice in another state and has demonstrated qualifications which equal or exceed those required under this act in the determination of the board.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed or certified in another state with qualifications equal to or exceeding Pennsylvania requirements; the other state must afford reciprocal treatment to Pennsylvania licensees.
requirements.quote: No license shall be granted under this section to an applicant unless the state in which the applicant is licensed affords reciprocal treatment to individuals who are residents of this Commonwealth and who are licensed under this act.

credential_type.quote: "License."  A license to practice massage therapy under this act.

is_mandatory.quote: an individual may not practice massage therapy or hold oneself out as a massage therapist unless licensed by the board.

title_protection.quote: No other individual may use the title "Licensed Massage Therapist" or the title "Massage Therapist" or hold oneself out to others as a massage therapist.

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice massage therapy as defined in this act without having, at the time of so doing, a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime of moral turpitude or a felony under federal or state law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted under Federal law, under the law of any state or under the law of another jurisdiction of a crime of moral turpitude or of an offense which, if committed in this Commonwealth, would constitute a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from acceptable and prevailing practice standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found to have engaged in immoral or unprofessional conduct. In proceedings based on this paragraph, actual injury to the client need not be established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating standards of professional practice or conduct established by board regulation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating standards of professional practice or conduct as established by board regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting false credentials, documents, or making a false statement in support of a license application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting false credentials or documents or making a false statement of fact in support of the individual's application for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a false or deceptive license renewal to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitting a false or deceptive license renewal to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license suspended, revoked, refused, or receiving other disciplinary action in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license suspended, revoked or refused or receiving other disciplinary action by the proper licensing authority of another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a board regulation or a prior board disciplinary order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a regulation promulgated by the board or violating an order of the board previously entered in a disciplinary proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, negligence, or misconduct in the practice of massage therapy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, negligence or misconduct in carrying out the practice of massage therapy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing beyond the licensee's defined scope of practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing beyond the licensee's defined scope of practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, hiring, or advising someone in the unlawful practice of massage therapy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, hiring or advising someone in the unlawful practice of massage therapy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, drunkenness, use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: An individual, corporation, partnership, firm or other entity may not employ an individual in massage therapy unless the individual is licensed by the board.

definition_quote.value: The application of a system of structured touch, pressure, movement, holding and treatment of the soft tissue manifestations of the human body in which the primary intent is to enhance the health and well-being of the client without limitation, except as provided in this act.
definition_quote.quote: "Massage therapy."  The application of a system of structured touch, pressure, movement, holding and treatment of the soft tissue manifestations of the human body in which the primary intent is to enhance the health and well-being of the client without limitation, except as provided in this act.

value: holding and treatment of soft tissue
external application of water, heat, cold, lubricants or other topical preparations
use of electro-mechanical devices which mimic or enhance massage techniques
methods_authorized.quote: The term includes the external application of water, heat, cold, lubricants or other topical preparations, lymphatic techniques, myofascial release techniques and the use of electro-mechanical devices which mimic or enhance the action of the massage techniques.

protected_titles.quote: No other individual may use the title "Licensed Massage Therapist" or the title "Massage Therapist" or hold oneself out to others as a massage therapist. This subsection includes advertising as a massage therapist and adopting or using any title or description, including massage therapist, massage practitioner, masseur, masseuse, myotherapist or a derivative of those terms and their related abbreviations

prohibited_titles.quote: adopting or using any title or description, including massage therapist, massage practitioner, masseur, masseuse, myotherapist or a derivative of those terms and their related abbreviations, which implies directly or indirectly that massage services are being provided

education_minimum_hours.quote: The applicant has completed a massage program of at least 600 hours of in-class, postsecondary education instruction approved by the board

value: human immunodeficiency virus and related risks
education_required_topics.quote: The program under this paragraph must include training in the human immunodeficiency virus and related risks and training in cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

cpr_certification_required_for_renewal.quote: Current certification to administer cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

temporary_practice_permit_available.quote: The board may issue a temporary practice permit to an applicant in order to permit the applicant to practice massage therapy during the six-month period after completion of the applicant's education program.

temporary_permit_duration_months.quote: six months from the date of issuance

temporary_permit_renewable.quote: The temporary practice permit issued under paragraph (1) shall be nonrenewable

value: diagnosis or treatment of impairment, illness, disease or disability
excluded_modalities.quote: The term does not include the diagnosis or treatment of impairment, illness, disease or disability, a medical procedure, a chiropractic manipulation - adjustment, physical therapy mobilization - manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, electrical stimulation, ultrasound or prescription of medicines for which a license to practice medicine, chiropractic, physical therapy, occupational therapy, podiatry or other practice of the healing arts is required.

value: electro-mechanical devices which mimic or enhance massage techniques
included_adjunct_modalities.quote: The term includes the external application of water, heat, cold, lubricants or other topical preparations, lymphatic techniques, myofascial release techniques and the use of electro-mechanical devices which mimic or enhance the action of the massage techniques.

value: practice by licensed, certified, or registered professionals within their scope
practice by Federal Government employees under Federal law
students enrolled in approved massage therapy education programs under supervision
touch to deepen awareness of existing patterns of movement in the body within scope of a profession with established standards and ethics
touch affecting energy systems, acupoints, Qi meridians, or channels of energy (acupressure, Asian bodywork therapy, polarity therapy bodywork, quigon, reiki, shiatsu, tui na)
exempted_practices.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed as preventing, restricting or requiring licensure of any of the following activities

reflexology_defined_separately.quote: "Reflexology."  The physical act of using thumbs, fingers and hand techniques to apply specific pressure on the reflex area in the feet, hands or ears of the client.

student_supervision_exemption.quote: A student enrolled in a massage therapy education program who is: (i) conducting massage therapy activities under the supervision of: (A) a licensee; or (B) instructors or supervisors who meet the licensing criteria of the Department of Education or the board

employer_licensure_obligation.quote: An individual, corporation, partnership, firm or other entity may not employ an individual in massage therapy unless the individual is licensed by the board.

inactive_status_available.quote: Any person licensed under this act may request an application for inactive status. The application may be completed and returned to the board; upon receipt of each application, the applicant shall be maintained on inactive status without fee

reactivation_ce_requirement_after_long_i.quote: Any person who requests an active status license who has been on inactive status for a period of five consecutive years or longer shall, prior to receiving an active license, satisfy the requirements of the board's regulations for ensuring continued competence and remit the required fee.

revocation_reapplication_waiting_period_.quote: An individual whose license has been revoked may reapply for a license after a period of at least five years

criminal_history_disqualifying_offense.value: Felony conviction under The Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act; exception if at least 10 years have elapsed and applicant demonstrates significant rehabilitation progress.
criminal_history_disqualifying_offense.quote: The applicant has not been convicted of a felony under the act of April 14, 1972 (P.L.233, No.64), known as The Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act, or of an offense under the laws of another jurisdiction which, if committed in this Commonwealth, would be a felony under The Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act, unless the following apply: (i)  At least ten years have elapsed from the date of conviction.

civil_penalty_maximum_dollars.quote: may levy a civil penalty of up to $10,000

continuing_education_excluded_topics.quote: No credit may be given for courses in office management or practice building.

continuing_education_hardship_waiver.quote: The board may waive all or part of the continuing education requirement to a licensee who shows to the satisfaction of the board that the licensee was unable to complete the requirement due to illness, emergency or hardship.

multi_state_licensure_reporting_required.quote: A licensee who is licensed to practice massage therapy in another jurisdiction shall report this information to the board on the license renewal application. Any disciplinary action taken in another jurisdiction shall be reported to the board on the license renewal application or within 90 days of final disposition, whichever is sooner.
